title: Synthetic MPC Minutes February 2022
text:

title: Synthetic Monetary Policy Statement August 2022
text:
Synthetic research fixture — not an RBI quotation.

The committee observed that disinflation was becoming visible while domestic demand remained uneven. Liquidity support may be calibrated to support growth without weakening price stability. Going forward, the policy stance will respond to the inflation outlook and incoming data. The current balance of risks was assessed as broadly neutral.

title: Synthetic MPC Minutes April 2024
text:

The future path could change if food-price uncertainty broadens. Earlier easing expectations had declined as inflation increased.

title: Synthetic Monetary Policy Statement May 2026
text:
